description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for Android hardware audio stream HAL using HIDL, including StreamHalHidl, StreamOutHalHidl, and StreamInHalHidl.

classes.name: StreamHalHidl
classes.description: Base class for Android hardware audio streams using HIDL, providing core stream functionalities.

classes.name: StreamOutHalHidl
classes.description: Derived class for output audio streams, supporting write, latency, volume, and effects.

classes.name: StreamInHalHidl
classes.description: Derived class for input audio streams, supporting read, gain, and microphone configurations.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns size of input/output buffer in bytes.

methods.name: getAudioProperties
methods.description: Returns the base configuration of the stream such as channel mask, format, and sample rate.

methods.name: addEffect
methods.description: Adds an effect to the stream.

methods.name: removeEffect
methods.description: Removes an effect from the stream.

methods.name: standby
methods.description: Puts the hardware input/output into standby mode.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the stream in mmap mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the stream in mmap mode.

methods.name: createMmapBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves information on the mmap buffer.

methods.name: getMmapPosition
methods.description: Gets current read/write position in the mmap buffer.

methods.name: setHalThreadPriority
methods.description: Sets thread priority for HAL interaction.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the frame size in bytes.

methods.name: getRenderPosition
methods.description: Returns number of frames written since standby.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for non-blocking write notifications.

methods.name: supportsDrain
methods.description: Checks if drain operation is supported.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Notifies hardware to play buffered data.

methods.name: getPresentationPosition
methods.description: Returns frames and timestamp of current playback position.

methods.name: getAudioDescriptionMixLevel
methods.description: Gets audio description mix level in dB.

methods.name: setAudioDescriptionMixLevel
methods.description: Sets audio description mix level in dB.

methods.name: callWriterThread
methods.description: Handles writing data in a separate thread.

methods.name: callReaderThread
methods.description: Handles reading data in a separate thread.
